text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision. To begin my assessment, can you describe the exact mechanism of the injury and how the injury occurred?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Right hip dislocation.

Based on your history of a rear-end collision, immediate onset of severe right groin pain, and the specific mechanism of injury, I am concerned about a hip dislocation. Can you confirm if your right leg is currently held in an abnormal position, specifically pointing outward or backward?
